source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    1. Send command: ipmitool sdr elist
Check sensor reading change when temperature increase or decrease.
2. Send command: ipmitool sensor list
Check sensor threshold(upper/lower warning/critical) match with the spec
3. Heat up the sensor until higher than the warning and critical threshold
Check SEL when sensor reach to threshold

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria:
1. Temperature should have a normal change behavior.
2. All setting should be correct and match with spec.(including sdr type)
3. SEL should have a correct log when sensor reach to each threshold.
4. System should have correct behavior, like shutdown or change fan speed, when reach to threshold.

original_test_intent: Exercise the platform sensor labeled TEMP CEMBB through approved warning and critical thresholds, verify its SDR and SEL transitions plus the correct protection response of the physical board zone it represents, then prove all affected paths recover.
original_method: An attended engineer changes the thermal condition at the mapped CEMBB region while BMC readings are observed; the source does not expand CEMBB or identify its board location, coupled components or safe way to reach the thresholds.
manual_activity: An engineer maps the CEMBB label to the exact board revision, sensor position and shared thermal domain, approves a spatially controlled fixture or chamber, operates it with abort authority, and owns board/chassis recovery. Automation can collect correlated evidence.
required_inputs: CEMBB definition, board/riser revision, physical sensor placement and stable SDR identity
map of nearby CEM connectors, retimers/switches, controllers, rails and airflow-coupled endpoints
units, accuracy, normal range, warning/critical limits, tolerance and hysteresis
qualified chamber or local-air fixture with probe placement, ramp, dwell, maximum, abort and cooldown
decoded SEL event data and expected fan, power, throttling, device/link or host response
independent board-zone probes, component/link/rail telemetry, log retention and recovery owner
safety_requirements: Do not infer that CEMBB is a CEM slot or generic baseboard location, and do not heat or obstruct an unmapped shared board region.

Monitor the target and adjacent board zones, attached endpoint temperatures, PCIe links/AER, retimers/controllers where exposed, power rails, fans, BMC and host; abort on overshoot, link/device loss, rail anomaly or instability.
Preserve the first device, link, power, BMC and SEL failure evidence; do not clear it or automatically retry.
Use approved authenticated access instead of DeepSeek's password exposure and host-key bypass.
Restore airflow and board cooling, then confirm every affected interface, endpoint, rail and host path is healthy before continuation.
agent_execution_scope: After setup, poll the exact CEMBB SDR, independent zone probes, coupled component temperatures, PCIe/device links, power/rails, fans, SEL and console state.
Correlate warning and critical events with the mapped physical board zone and declared protection matrix rather than accepting the CEMBB channel alone.
Verify cooldown, SEL deassertion and recovery throughout the coupled domain.
Do not select or heat the board area, alter thresholds, clear logs, reset components or issue PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Approve CEMBB meaning, physical/coupling map, limits, event/protection matrix, fixture and complete recovery plan.
Operate the environmental setup with physical oversight and abort authority.
Evaluate distributed anomalies and issue the DUT verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The SDR/sensor lists provide baseline inventory only; they cannot stimulate CEMBB, inspect SEL, locate the shared board zone or prove coupled-component recovery.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use trusted IPMI/SEL collection plus independent board-zone probes and synchronized link/device/rail/fan/host telemetry under an engineer-controlled spatially bounded stimulus.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The original commands, CEMBB label, threshold-crossing method, script and 5/10-minute values remain preserved; actual fixture and dwell come from the Project plan.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Map the sensor and coupled board domain, baseline all affected paths, apply a bounded local or chamber condition, correlate distributed events/protection, then restore cooling and prove domain recovery.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Exact chassis, CEM/baseboard/riser revision, population and airflow topology.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record board/chassis revision, BIOS/BMC/SDR, endpoint/controller firmware, fixture and probe versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Vendor CEMBB physical/thermal map, board component limits, SEL mapping and chassis recovery SOP.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds exact physical placement, spatial probe confirmation and coupled interface/rail recovery evidence.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A BMC sensor transition alone cannot prove that the intended board zone or every affected component was safely exercised and restored.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Physical/coupling map, limits, event/protection matrix and recovery.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Local heat or airflow obstruction at a shared board zone may affect multiple links, endpoints or rails before the reported sensor reaches its threshold.

project_override_considerations: Project SPEC may select chamber versus qualified local-air stimulus and define only the components actually coupled on that board revision; it must retain the CEMBB functional objective and record uncovered paths and method-equivalence limits.
expected_evidence: chassis/board/riser identity, CEMBB definition, sensor location/SDR and coupled-domain map
approved spatial stimulus, probe placement, calibrated envelope and abort record
timestamped CEMBB and adjacent-zone temperatures plus link/device/rail/fan/host state
decoded warning/critical SEL assert/deassert entries and protection timing
restored airflow, distributed cooldown/deassertion, component/link/rail/host/BMC health and engineer verdict

review_improvement: Treats CEMBB as an unmapped shared physical board zone whose sensor, nearby interfaces and power paths must be correlated, not as another generic temperature name.
independent_technical_reasoning: The source's target label plus dynamic criteria are enough to preserve the functional intent, while the platform owner can supply the exact physical meaning. Because a common board-zone stimulus can have a wider and earlier blast radius than the reported sensor, physical operation stays manual and the monitoring matrix extends beyond IPMI.
